notes: D1 oracle is the official RET Metrolijnenkaart, HAND-TRANSCRIBED from Luke's Expansion brief. Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.
City id rotterdam is a SEPARATE city from amsterdam. Same OVapi agency family and same no-key GTFS/GTFS-RT, filtered to RET metro A–E. Do not merge into amsterdam. Do not invent city=nl or the-hague.
Oracle JSON status may stay planned. Product flip to tester-live is Jim D2–D6 (registry live + picker).
Modes v1: TRAIN-like metro only (RET A–E). No tram, bus, waterbus, or NS.
Hub lock: Beurs (all five lines). Not Rotterdam, not CS, not Centraal Station.
Rotterdam Centraal is a D terminus and an E through-stop. doNotGroup metro vs NS at Rotterdam Centraal.
Den Haag Centraal is a Metro E stop on city rotterdam. Do not add a Hague city. Hague/Utrecht tram-skip still applies.
Locked map forms: Meijersplein/Airport and Hoek van Holland Strand.
71 unique stops. A=20, B=32, C=26, D=17, E=23.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is the passenger letter. OVapi route_id is versioned — do not treat the numeric suffix as a print lock. No stopIds in this file.
coverageGaps: RET tram, bus, and waterbus are out of v1.
NS Intercity/Sprinter at Rotterdam Centraal, Schiedam Centrum, Blaak, Alexander, Den Haag Centraal, Laan van NOI, Hoek van Holland Haven are out of v1. doNotGroup metro vs NS.
HTM RandstadRail trams that share Den Haag Centraal / Laan van NOI are out of v1. Metro E stays on rotterdam.
GVB metro M50–M54 belongs to amsterdam. Do not leak into rotterdam.
A peak extras to Vlaardingen West are not the printed A termini (Binnenhof–Schiedam Centrum).
D peak extras toward Pijnacker Zuid are Metro E territory. Printed D termini are Rotterdam Centraal–De Akkers.
